topic_en: Rust control flow: if is an expression, plus loop, while and for

xhs.title: Rust 的 if 居然能直接赋值？
xhs.body:
第 5 课：控制流
if 是表达式：let x = if ok { 1 } else { 0 };
两个分支类型必须一样，所以 Rust 没有三元运算符
loop 一直转，break 还能带值出来
while 看条件，for 遍历数组和范围（0..3 不含 3）
考考你：let n = if true { 1 } else { "one" }; 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: In Rust, if is an expression, so it can give a value. Plus loop, while and for in one minute. Quick quiz: let n = if true { 1 } else { "one" };  Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: In Rust, if gives you a value
linkedin.body:
if is an expression: let x = if ok { 1 } else { 0 };
Both branches must have the same type, so Rust needs no ternary operator.
loop runs until break, and break can return a value.
while checks a condition; for walks arrays and ranges (0..3 is 0, 1, 2).
Quick quiz: let n = if true { 1 } else { "one" };  Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: let n = if true { 1 } else { "one" }; 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: let n = if true { 1 } else { "one" };  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。if 是表达式，两个分支必须是同一种类型：1 是整数，"one" 是 &str。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. if is an expression, so both branches must have the same type: 1 is an integer, "one" is a &str.
